spans.s: खंकरः A curl, a lock of hair.

खंज् {c1c} P. (खंजति) To limp, halt,
walk lame; खंजन् प्रभंजनजनः पथिकः
पिपासुः

खंज a. [खंज्-अच्] Lame, crippled,
halt; पादेन खंजः Sk.;

; नेत्रे
खंजनगंजने S. D; एको हि खंजनवरो
नलिनीदलस्थः Ś.

.
--ना
1 A kind
of wag-tail.
--2 Mustard.
--नं Going
lamely.
--Comp.
--रतं the
cohabitation of saints.

खंजनकः A wag-tail; (also खंजनिका
in this sense).

खंड् {c10c} P. (खंडयति, खंडित)
1 To
break, cut, tear, break to pieces,
crush;

; Śi. 7. 31, 20. 24,
6. 16, 12. 3.
--2 To defeat completely,
destroy, dispel; रजनीचरनाथेन खंडिते
तिमिरे निशि

.
--3 To
disappoint; frustrate, cross in love;
स्त्रीभिः कस्य न खंडितं भुवि मनः

खंड a. [खंड्-घञ्]
1 Broken, divided,
torn asunder; ˚देवकुलं

a temple
in ruins.
--2 Having chasms,
gaps or breaks.
--3 Defective,
deficient.
--डः, --डं
1 A break, chasm,
gap, fissure, fracture.
--2 A piece,
part, fragment, portion; दिवः
कांतिमत्खंडमेकं

; काष्ठ˚, मांस˚ &c.
--3
A section of a work, chapter.
--4 A
multitude, an assemblage, group;
तरुखंडस्य

.
--5 A term in an equation.
--डः
1
Candied sugar.
--2 A flaw in a jewel.
--डं
1 A kind of salt.
--2 A sort of
sugar-cane. (In comp. खंड means
‘partial,’ ‘incomplete’).
--Comp.
--अभ्रं
{1} scattered clouds. {2} the impression
of the teeth in amorous sports.
--आलिः {1} a measure of oil. {2} a
pond or lake. {3} a woman whose
[]
husband has been guilty of
infidelity.
--कथा a short tale.
--कर्णः {1} a
kind of bulbous plant. {2} sweet
potato.
--काव्यं a small poem, such
as the मेघदूत; it is thus defined:
खंडकाव्यं भवेत् काव्यस्यैकदेशानुसारि च
S.

.
--जः a kind of sugar.
--धारा scissors.
--परशुः {1} an
epithet of Śiva; महैश्वर्यं
लीलाजनितजगतः खंडपरशोः G.

.
{2} an epithet of Paraśurāma, son
of Jamadagni. {3} an epithet of
Viṣṇu.
--पर्शुः {1} N. of Śiva. {2} of
Paraśurāma. {3} of Rāhu. {4} an
elephant with a broken tusk.
--पालः
a confectioner.
--प्रलयः {1} a partial
destruction of the universe in which
all the spheres beneath Svarga are
dissolved in one common ruin. {2}
a quarrel.
--मंडल a. gibbous, not full
or round.
--(लं) the segment of a
circle.
--मोदकः a kind of sugar.
--लवणं a kind of salt.
--विकारः sugar.
--शर्करा candied sugar.
--शीला a
loose woman, an unchaste wife.

खंडक a. [खंड्-ण्वुल्] Destroying,
tearing, breaking to pieces, removing,
&c.
--कः, --कं A fragment, part or
piece.
--कः
1 Candied sugar.
--2 One
who has no nails.
--Comp.
--आलु n.
sweet potato.

खंडन a. [खंड्-ल्युट्]
1 Breaking,
cutting, dividing.
--2 Destroying,
annihilating; स्मरगरलखंडनं मम शिरसि
मंडनं

; भवज्वरखंडन 12.
--नं
1
Breaking or cutting.
--2 Biting;
injuring, hurting; अधरोष्ठखंडनं

.
--3 Disappointing,
frustrating (as in love).
--4 Interrupting;
रसखंडनवर्जितं

खंडनीय, खंडयितव्य pot. p.
1 To be
broken, frangible, brittle.
--2
Destructible.
--3 Refutable &c.

खंडनीय, खंडयितव्य pot. p.
1 To be
broken, frangible, brittle.
--2
Destructible.
--3 Refutable &c.

खंडशस् ind.
1 To pieces, into
fragments; ˚कृ to cut into pieces.
--2 Bit by bit, piece by piece,
piece-meal.

खंडिकः [खंड्-अस्त्यर्थे ठन्]
1 A
sugar-boiler.
--2 Pease.
--3 The
armpit.
--का
1 The food of pease.
--2 A
[]
kind of air or tune (in music).

खंडित p. p. [खंड्-क्त]
1 Cut,
broken in pieces.
--2 Destroyed,
annihilated, lost, decayed; खंडित च
वसुनि

.
--3 Refuted (in
argument), controverted.
--4 Rebelled.
--5 Disappointed, betrayed,
abandoned; खंडितयुवतिविलापं

.
--ता A
woman whose husband or lover
has been guilty of infidelity, and who
is therefore angry with him; one of the
{8} principal Nāyikās in Sanskrit;

. She is thus described:
--पार्श्वमेति प्रियो यस्या अन्यसंभोगचिह्रितः । सा
खंडितेति कथिता धीरैरीर्ष्याकषायिता
S.

.
--Comp.
--विग्रह a. maimed,
mutilated.
--वृत्त a. immoral, dissolute,
abandoned;

खंडिन् a. [खंड-इनि]
1 Consisting of
parts, in pieces or parts.
--2
Divided.
--नी The earth.

खंडीकृ {c8c} U. To divide, tear to
pieces, cut up.

खंड्य a.
1 To be broken or
divided, fragile.
--2 Destructible.

खन् {c1c} U. (खनति-ते, खात; pass.
खन्यते or खायते)
1 To dig up, delve,
excavate; खनन्नाखुबिलं सिंहः

.
--2 To dig
into the earth, bury.

खनक a. [खन्-वुन्]
1 Digging,
dividing.
--2 A digger, excavator.
--कः
1 A miner.
--2 A house-breaker.
--3 A rat.
--4 A mine.

खानक a. (निका f.) [खन्-ण्वुल्]
One who digs, a miner.

खनित्रं [खन्-इत्र] A spade, hoe,
a pick-axe.

खनित्रिम a. Ved. Produced by
digging;

खानिकः, --कं A hole in a wall,
breach.

खानिकः, --कं A hole in a wall,
breach.

खांडं The state of having
fractures or gaps.

खांडवः Sugar-candy.
--वं N. of
a forest in Kurukṣetra, sacred to
Indra, and burnt by Agni with the
assistance of Arjuna and Kṛṣṇa.
--Comp.
--प्रस्थः N. of a town.
